set.body:
docs/api-stability.md is a D1A/D1B migration note and has no stable/experimental table. The release gate bd-01M2TAMJ95K9D7H248A8387YW4 AC1 names a stable set in prose only. Four maintenance beads cannot be ranked until the list exists: bd-01M17GC475EPDVW5Z4D776AYH0 (causal licensing basis on CausalProposal), bd-01M17AGFAVE90MA9QS50V0FTZD (support accessor grain), bd-01M16E05TWX28QKJF2GFY67ZZV (RecallSignature fields and public case-class constructor), bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV (Estimate Ineligible arm). The pre-freeze construction audit bd-01M19N0W937KVZCK78F6X57X1D needs the list as its population.

Acceptance:
1. docs/api-stability.md gains a table that classifies each public package or type family as stable, experimental or internal for 1.0, with a one-line reason. At minimum it decides: mapping facade, G1 mapping records and G2 exchange tables; typed SourceView; HsmmResult; RecallSignature; features Estimate/FeatureTrack/reducers; provider proposal payloads (CausalProposal and siblings); StoryModel and NarrativeCompiler (per ruling E or the P1 outcome); media and corpus-intake adapters.
2. Each of the four beads above receives a decision note (fix before the freeze, or experimental -> P3) and its priority is set to match. Any release-gate edge the table makes unnecessary is removed, including bd-01M1DA6NJXYT4NEA18745FM3KY if invocation-authenticated HSMM totals are not advertised.
3. The table states the binary-compatibility promise for stable types (MiMa from 1.0.0 onward, per bd-01M2TAKTB61XNXV4Y6A9J3CB0C) and that experimental types carry none.
4. The owner confirms the table. Per SD5, the rejected alternatives are recorded in the same commit.

No code change in this bead.
set.title: [release] Decide the 1.0 stable-type list (stability table) before API-shape work
